Partner Activation Trigger Undefined
Description:
Risk: Partner approval/sync trigger is not finalized.
Impact: Premature or delayed partner creation.
Mitigation: Define one activation status with contract, diligence, training and data checks.

Title: Master Data Ownership Gap
Description:
Risk: Master-data ownership and edit rights remain open.
Impact: Unauthorized changes may affect orders, credit, invoicing and contracts.
Mitigation: Keep records read-only initially and implement controlled approval.

Title: Cross-Region Partner Validation
Description:
Risk: Cross-region partner scenarios are not validated.
Impact: Incorrect legal-entity routing or missing visibility.
Mitigation: Validate global and multi-region cases before security design is finalized.

Title: ZINFI Capability Alignment
Description:
Risk: Detailed ZINFI capability/design requires follow-up.
Impact: Assumptions may not align with configuration, integration or licensing.
Mitigation: Validate parked items with ZINFI specialists.

Title: Partner CRM Adoption
Description:
Risk: Partners may resist duplicate CRM entry.
Impact: Low adoption, incomplete pipeline and unreliable forecasts.
Mitigation: Use bulk import, simplified forms and proportionate mandatory reporting.

Title: Regional Sales Model Variation
Description:
Risk: Regional lead/opportunity models differ.
Impact: A single process may overburden some partners or under-serve others.
Mitigation: Use common minimum data with region/portfolio variations.

Title: Deal Registration Design Gap
Description:
Risk: Deal registration and matching are not designed.
Impact: Partner versus partner or partner versus direct conflict.
Mitigation: Define matching, reservation, approval, rejection, expiry and override rules.

Title: Contract & Pricing Ownership
Description:
Risk: Contract/pricing ownership is unresolved.
Impact: Inconsistent pricing, discounts, rebates and entitlements.
Mitigation: Complete contract fit-gap and define authoritative system ownership.

Title: Installed-Base Location Ownership
Description:
Risk: Installed-base location/change ownership is unresolved.
Impact: Inaccurate serialized-device location and service/recall risk.
Mitigation: Define trigger, ownership, validation and approval for location updates.

Title: Receive Partner Planning data points from ZINFI
Description: As a user, I need to synchronize only agreed partner-plan data points needed for reporting and downstream use, so that partner coverage and performance can be managed consistently.

Title: Classify Partners by Business Model
Description: As a account manager, I need to capture distributor/dealer, manufacturer representative, sales partner, service partner or service-only partner classification. - Classify stocking, non-stocking, just-in-time, manufacturer representative and government/military partner models, so that partner information is accurate and available for downstream processes.
Acceptance Criteria: • Only the agreed planning details are received from ZINFI.• The data points are linked to the correct partner;

Title: Assign Partners to Region and Legal Entity
Description: As a user, I need to assign the synchronized partner to the applicable HeartStream region and legal entity, so that partner information is accurate and available for downstream processes.
Acceptance Criteria: • Partner type recorded against the partner.• Changes to the partner type are recorded.

Title: Make Synchronized Partner Data Read-Only
Description: As a Account manager, I need to restrict general CRM users from editing core partner master data received from ZINFI, so that partner data remains controlled and auditable.
Acceptance Criteria: • Each partner is assigned to the correct region and company.

Title: Restrict Partner Visibility by Region
Description: As a user, I need to allow authorized users to view partner records for their region or legal entity, so that partner information is protected and visible only to authorized users.
Acceptance Criteria: i• Only approved administrators can change these details. • Users see a clear message when a change is not allowed. • Allowed changes are recorded.

Title: Grant Approved Cross-Region Partner Access
Description: As a user, I need to grant approved users visibility to partners spanning multiple regions or legal entities, so that partner information is protected and visible only to authorized users.
Acceptance Criteria: • Users see only partners for their permitted region or company.• Restricted partners do not appear in lists, searches or reports.

Title: Synchronize Training and Certification Status
Description: As a account manager, I need to synchronize required partner training and certification status from ZINFI, so that partner readiness and certification compliance are visible.
Acceptance Criteria: • Approved users can access partners in more than one region or company.• They see only the regions or companies specifically assigned to them.
• Training and certification status are received from ZINFI.• Each record is linked to the correct partner and person. • Completed, in-progress and expired statuses are shown correctly.
